sources.snippet: Overview krea2_turbo_style_reference is a LoRA (Low-Rank Adapter) trained by ostris that enables style transfer on the Krea 2 Turbo model using reference images. Rather than requiring a trigger word, this adapter accepts 1-2 reference images alongside text prompts to apply their visual style to generated content. The LoRA was trained using the AI Toolkit's experimental Krea2 reference image ...
